scope: Experimental1214n on 1214m (#14 multi-enemy combat): Dead (host -> client) reconciles an NPC death the host's combat channel never shared (take 1270c: a host finisher on an unaware guard was never captured; the client's replica stayed alive). After a 1.5 s grace the host sends Dead for a corpse whose combat channel holds no pending or committed death; the client kills its replica silently with kill_no_reaction_damage (world attacker) inside the native entry, releasing its AI at the lethal subtraction as for a shared death. Stream JSON records each channel's corpse and death share.
